enforcementMechanism: Upfront pricing clarity: explicit 3-day trial terms, no hidden fees
1-click self-service cancellation in Workspace Billing Settings

regimes.citation: Portugal CIVA Art. 52, Art. 123.º CIRC; EU Directive 2010/45/EU; IRS 7-Year Rule
